web.title_en: ShieldBreak Vulnerability: How Windows Defender Became an Attack Path for Privilege Escalation
web.description_en: This article reveals how the ShieldBreak vulnerability exploits Windows Defender's own trusted mechanisms to bypass Microsoft's latest patches, achieving a 100% successful system privilege escalation that completely overturns the traditional belief that patched equals secure. It emphasizes that when attackers leverage defense tools themselves as attack paths, passive defenses relying solely on signature recognition are obsolete. A shift toward deterministic prevention technologies that do not depend on tool integrity is imperative.
